review: Reuses the source-reviewed arrival fact and absent-parentage labels from issue #2. No model output was used to create these labels. Neither human review nor independent canon corroboration is claimed.

cases.question: When does Phil Mitchell first arrive in Walford?

required_facts.fact: Phil Mitchell first arrives in Walford in February 1990.

scoring.matching: Exact evidence IDs within the fixed snapshot; deduplicate retrieval IDs before taking top k.
scoring.retrieval_denominator: Recall divides relevant retrieved passages by all labelled relevant passages. Hit and reciprocal first-relevant rank are defined only for cases with relevant passages. Zero-relevance cases are null, not perfect scores.
scoring.context_denominator: Fraction of required facts with at least one complete labelled sufficient evidence set in the actual whole-span context. No required facts gives null coverage. An unanswerable case cannot have sufficient context for the requested fact.
scoring.limitation: Two exposed cases, one positive, one negative, one source passage and one fact group. No held-out performance, meaningful rank discrimination, persona assessment or general answer-quality conclusion. A nearest neighbour may be returned for the negative case without supplying the requested fact.
